blocks.translation: Shadow Hearts 2 DC
Around 2006

blocks.source: 質量
blocks.translation: Content Volume

blocks.source: 質量共に前作とは比較にならないレベルでパワーアップしている本作。テンポが大幅に向上しているにも関わらずプレイ時間は３０時間以上。狭かった町やダンジョンも広くなった。終盤のサブイベントで探索可能なダンジョンも豊富。
blocks.translation: This game has been powered up to a level that makes it incomparable to its predecessor in both quantity and quality. Despite its greatly improved pacing, it takes over 30 hours to complete. The previously cramped towns and dungeons have also been expanded. There are plenty of dungeons to explore in side events toward the end of the game.

blocks.source: 前作から一転、大手メーカーの大作ＲＰＧにも見劣りしないクオリティだが、これだけの作品を作り切る予算をどこから調達したのだろう？
blocks.translation: A complete turnaround from its predecessor, its quality stands up against big-budget RPGs from major manufacturers. But where did they get the budget to finish a game of this scale?

blocks.source: 物語
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: 前作シャドウハーツをプレイしていないと話が意味不明なのでプレイは必須。前作のバッドエンドから繋がるという一風変わった構成が特徴。
blocks.translation: Playing the previous game, Shadow Hearts, is essential, as the story makes little sense otherwise. Its unusual structure, which follows directly from the previous game's bad ending, is one of its defining features.

blocks.source: 物語は１９１５年の第一次世界大戦時からスタート。前半はヨーロッパ。後半は日本で展開される。 前作の雰囲気から一転、ギャグやパロディが豊富に。特に『漢祭り』のハジケっぷりは良い子が引いてしまうレベル。それでも、シリアスな部分は非常にシリアスという独特なノリ。
blocks.translation: The story begins in 1915, during World War I. The first half takes place in Europe, while the second half unfolds in Japan. In a complete departure from the atmosphere of the previous game, it is packed with gags and parodies. The particularly outrageous antics of the “Man Festival” are enough to make even well-behaved children recoil. Even so, its distinctive tone makes the serious parts extremely serious.

blocks.source: 前作から引き続き主役を務めるウルを始め、個性の強い仲間キャラの存在が光る。ただ、ゼペットやルチアの様に影が薄いキャラクターも。
blocks.translation: The presence of the strongly individualistic party members shines, beginning with Yuri, who continues as the protagonist from the previous game. However, some characters, such as Gepetto and Lucia, are rather forgettable.

blocks.source: 前半はやや展開が遅めだが王道な感じ。後半はややシリアスな雰囲気に。ただ、雰囲気が変わりすぎて、主人公や敵の考え方や行動に飛躍が多くて、ついていけないこともあった。なんせ、前半のゆるめの雰囲気が好きだったもんで。
blocks.translation: The first half has a somewhat slow pace but feels like a classic adventure. The second half takes on a somewhat more serious atmosphere. However, the change in tone is so drastic that the protagonist's and enemies' thoughts and actions often make huge leaps, and I sometimes had trouble keeping up. I simply preferred the more relaxed atmosphere of the first half.

blocks.source: 前作の登場人物の中には違和感のある変化を遂げているキャラクターも。特にラスボスはどうしてこうなった。ラストバトル～エンディングは正直、超展開の部類かも……。
blocks.translation: Some characters from the previous game undergo changes that feel out of place. The final boss in particular makes me wonder how things came to this. Honestly, the final battle through the ending may fall into the category of an utterly wild plot development...

blocks.source: システム
blocks.translation: System

blocks.source: 前作にあった『ジャッジメントリング』を今回も継承。『リングカスタム』によって威力を落とす代わりにタイミングの幅を広げる等の調整が可能になった。『リングアイテム』によって、攻撃回数を増加させることが可能だ。リングアイテムの入手には各地に点在する『リングの魂』との会話が必要だが、この会話にも一々ギャグが入っている凝りっぷり。
blocks.translation: The “Judgment Ring” from the previous game returns. “Ring Custom” now allows adjustments such as widening the timing window at the cost of power. “Ring Items” can be used to increase the number of attacks. Obtaining Ring Items requires speaking with the “Souls of the Ring” scattered throughout the world, and even these conversations are packed with carefully crafted gags.

blocks.source: 主人公の『フュージョン』を始め、各キャラクターが個性を生かした特技を持っている。
blocks.translation: Starting with the protagonist's “Fusion,” each character has Techs that make use of their individual strengths.

blocks.source: また、今回は紋章を装備することで『紋章魔法』が使えるようになる。紋章は７０種類以上も存在する。１つの紋章でも複数の魔法を使用でき、さらにその紋章を１人のキャラクターが複数装備できるという構成。
blocks.translation: This time, equipping crests allows you to use “Crest Magic.” There are more than 70 types of crests. A single crest can provide multiple spells, and one character can equip multiple crests at once.

blocks.source: 重複した魔法を使用できる紋章を同時に装備すると、消費ＭＰが下がるという特典がある。これが非常に強力で回復魔法等をかなり小さなコストで使用できる。
blocks.translation: Equipping multiple crests that provide the same spells grants the benefit of reduced MP consumption. This is extremely powerful, allowing recovery spells and the like to be used at a very low cost.

blocks.source: 前作同様、主人公はフュージョンによって、様々な魔物に変身することができる。ただし、攻撃力が高い炎属性の変身だけで事足りる印象。アモンなどストーリー進行に関わる魔物に変身できるようになっても、あまり使い道は無いかも。
blocks.translation: As in the previous game, the protagonist can use Fusion to transform into various monsters. However, the impression is that the high-attack-power fire-element transformation alone is sufficient. Even after gaining the ability to transform into monsters involved in story progression, such as Amon, there may not be much use for them.

blocks.source: バランス
blocks.translation: Balance

blocks.source: 難易度は低め。雑魚戦は敵が一度も攻撃しないまま終わることも多い。ボス戦では全体回復や蘇生が容易で、なかなか全滅しない。ただし、雑魚敵に不意打ちされると、成すすべなく大ダメージを受けることも……。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is on the low side. Many random battles end without the enemies attacking even once. In boss battles, party-wide healing and revival are easy, so it is difficult to suffer a total party wipe. However, being ambushed by random enemies can sometimes result in heavy damage with no way to respond...

blocks.source: 前作と比較して、ダラダラと時間の掛かる戦闘が大きく減ったのは好印象。
blocks.translation: Compared to the previous game, the substantial reduction in drawn-out battles is a welcome improvement.

blocks.source: アイテムが目印も何もなく、そこら中に落ちているのはちょっと意地悪。特に紋章は集めないと発生しないイベントがあるのに、数が多いから大変。
blocks.translation: It is somewhat mean-spirited to scatter items everywhere without any markers or other indications. Crests are especially troublesome: there are events that will not occur unless you collect them, and there are so many of them.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Usability

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポが非常に高速になった。前作の長いエフェクトや遅い通常攻撃が劇的に改善されている。 目押し中心の戦闘は前作よりテンポが速いとは言え、やはり面倒な部分も。
blocks.translation: The battle pace has become extremely fast. The previous game's lengthy effects and slow standard attacks have been dramatically improved. Although the timing-focused battles are faster-paced than in the previous game, they can still be tedious at times.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 前作の特徴だったグロテスクなモンスターデザインは押さえ気味。味は消えたが無難に。
blocks.translation: The grotesque monster designs that characterized the previous game have been toned down. The distinctive flavor is gone, but the results are safe and solid.

blocks.source: グラフィックの美しさはＰＳ２でも最高峰。演出力も前作より格段に向上して、ＦＦＸにも負けないレベル。後半、大正時代の日本の描写は中々雰囲気があって良いと思う。
blocks.translation: The graphics are among the finest on the PlayStation 2. The direction has also improved dramatically over the previous game, reaching a level that can rival Final Fantasy X. In the second half, I think the depictions of Japan during the Taisho era have a wonderful atmosphere.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 弘田佳孝氏がメイン作曲者。光田康典氏や伊藤賢治氏も参加。一番印象に残ったのはタイトルデモ。雰囲気にはあっているが、強烈に印象に残った曲は少なめ。伊藤賢治氏の戦闘曲は良曲ではあるが、無難な作りでサガシリーズほどのインパクトには欠ける。といって、いつもの個性を存分に発揮されたら作品の雰囲気を壊しそう……。
blocks.translation: Yoshitaka Hirota is the main composer, with Yasunori Mitsuda and Kenji Ito also contributing. The title demo left the strongest impression on me. Although it suits the atmosphere, there are relatively few truly memorable tracks. Kenji Ito's battle music is good, but its safe, conventional composition lacks the impact of the SaGa series. Then again, if he had fully displayed his usual individuality, it might have disrupted the atmosphere of the game...

lines.translation: The Director's Cut (DC) version of Shadow Hearts 2, the sequel to 『[[LINK_1]]Shadow Hearts[[/LINK_1]]』. The DC version includes additional content and fixes bugs, so this version is recommended for purchase.
